RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.label: records archive
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.description: Shelves this gate's facility keeps its records on. Recovered books, route notes and case files belong on a linked shelf rather than wherever a hauler happened to drop them.\n\nLink as many as the facility needs. They do not have to be in the same room as the gate, or anywhere near it - only on the same map and the same branch.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.label: analysis equipment
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.description:
The benches and analysers this gate's facility does its work on. A multi-analyzer, a research bench, or several of each.

Powered equipment must be on the same power network as the gate. Unpowered equipment has no network to be on, so it is accepted anywhere on the branch.

Linking a multi-analyzer here does not stop it boosting a research bench in the ordinary way.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.label: engineering tooling
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.description: Tool cabinets for the engineers who keep a gate working. A large installation keeps them where the work is rather than in one central store.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.label: quarantine beds
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.description: Beds this facility keeps apart for anybody who came back from a coordinate wrong. A crew that walked through something is looked at here before they are let near the rest of the branch.\n\nKeep medicine on the linked beds. A quarantine with none is a room with a label on the door.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.label: armory
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.description: Where this facility keeps what a crew carries in. Shelves linked here are the branch's armory, and what is on them is what an expedition can be sent out with.\n\nCore ships no weapon rack, so this is shelves. A shelf in a bedroom with a rifle on it is not an armory - only what is linked here counts.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.label: relief station
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.description: A second, third or fourth communications console wired to the same gate, so the window does not depend on one person staying put. Any qualified staff member at any of them holds the connection, and one can stand up to eat the moment another sits down.\n\nThis is never the gate's own control console; that one is already the first station. Build these where people actually are.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.label: radio room
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.description: A communications console kept for listening rather than for running the gate. Fragments come up on it that nobody transmitted.\n\nThis is never the gate's own control console; that one is bound separately and is refused here. A radio room is a second console the branch chose to build.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.label: receiving bay
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.description: Where the company's deliveries are put down and where recovered cargo is stacked before anybody sorts it. A facility without one ends up with the corridor as its receiving bay.\n\nKeep raw materials here. It is the stock an installation runs on and the first thing a long opening eats through.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.label: canteen
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.description: Where a crew eats before they go in and after they come out. Tables and a stove, linked so the branch knows it has somewhere to feed the people it sends down.\n\nKeep prepared meals here. A crew that goes in hungry is a crew that comes back worse.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.label: containment
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.description: Holding platforms and bioferrite equipment, linked as this facility's containment wing. A branch that decides to contain what it brings back needs somewhere built for it rather than a shelf and a hope.\n\nThis role only exists if the Anomaly expansion is installed. Without it the branch contains records on paper, which is what the rest of the mod does anyway.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.label: biological laboratory
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.description: Gene and mechanoid equipment linked as this facility's biological wing. What comes back from a coordinate is not always a thing on a shelf, and a branch with this bench can work on the rest of it.\n\nThis role only exists if the Biotech expansion is installed. Nothing the mod needs to operate depends on it.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.label: assembly room
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.description: A room the branch gathers in: somewhere to be presentable, somewhere to be heard, and something to make a noise with. Crews that come back from a coordinate do not go straight back to work.\n\nThis role only exists if the Ideology expansion is installed.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.label: off-world logistics
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Gate.RimroomsGat.description: A gravitational engine on the branch's books, so the company can account for a facility that is able to leave. A branch that can move is a branch whose gate is not the only way anything arrives.\n\nThis role only exists if the Odyssey expansion is installed, and the gate works exactly the same without it.
